channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemeni forces, Houthis exchange attacks, claim to inflict heavy losses
item.description: Yemen's government says 190 rebel fighters killed and wounded, as Houthis also claim inflicting heavy losses.

item.title: Ebola cases in DR Congo pass 11,000, with 5,387 deaths
item.description: Authorities struggling to contain DRC's largest Ebola outbreak due to delayed detection and conflict.

item.title: Iran opens training camp for women in readiness for war
item.description: Iran has opened its first all-women military training camp amid fears of renewed US attacks.

item.title: El Salvador fires missiles on Haitian gang hideout
item.description: El Salvador’s military fired rockets at a compound allegedly belonging to the leader of Haiti’s 400 Mawozo gang.

item.title: US charges 3 men over alleged Iranian-backed plot at UK Fairford air base
item.description: The men, including one who is already in jail, face charges over alleged plot at UK air base used in US war on Iran.

item.title: Republicans block Hegseth impeachment motion
item.description: Republicans have blocked a motion to impeach US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth over the war on Iran.

item.title: Iran war live: US House blocks Hegseth impeachment with 11 Democrats absent
item.description: US House blocks bid to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over US-Israel war on Iran as 11 Democrats miss vote.

item.title: Fire contained on platform in Iran’s South Pars gas field
item.description: Officials are considering a gas leak or an operational mishap as possible causes of the fire, Fars news agency said.

item.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
item.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

item.title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.
